title: Decomposing the C-index
text: Write concordance index weighted average comparable pairs, Cw=∑ijwijcij∑ijwij,C_w = \frac{\sum_{ij} w_{ij} c_{ij}}{\sum_{ij} w_{ij}}, cij∈{0,0.5,1}c_{ij} \\{0, 0.5, 1\} records whether pair ranked correctly. Splitting pairs status later subject gives Cw=WeeCee+WecCecWee+Wec,C_w = \frac{W_{ee} C_{ee} + W_{ec} C_{ec}}{W_{ee} + W_{ec}}, WW denoting sums weights. identity holds exactly every weighting – algebraic regrouping sum, approximation. global figure agrees survival::concordance() exactly:
code: set.seed(7) n <- 400 risk <- rnorm(n) event_time <- rexp(n, rate = exp(0.8 * risk) * 0.1) cens_time <- rexp(n, rate = 0.08) time <- pmin(event_time, cens_time) status <- as.numeric(event_time <= cens_time)  fit <- decompose_cindex(time, status, risk, n_boot = 200) fit #> C-Index Decomposition #> Weighting: Harrell | n = 400, events = 224 (56.0%), censoring 44.0% #>  #>                     C-index       pairs    share   95% CI #>   Event-Event        0.6235      24,976    53.3%   [0.5789, 0.6709] #>   Event-Censored     0.7736      21,871    46.7%   [0.7236, 0.8228] #>   ----------------------------------------------------------------- #>   Global             0.6936      46,847   100.0%   [0.6558, 0.7372] #>  #>   Masking gap (C_ec - C_ee): +0.150   [+0.101, +0.202] c(   cindexdecomp = fit$C_global,   survival = concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ risk, reverse = TRUE)$concordance ) #> cindexdecomp     survival  #>    0.6935983    0.6935983

title: Decomposing the C-index
text: cindexdecomp implements Uno’s estimator published pairwise form: every comparable pair weighted 1/Ĝ(Ti)21/\hat{G}(T_i)^2, Ĝ\hat G Kaplan-Meier estimate censoring distribution. survival::concordance(timewt = "n/G2") uses counting-process formulation applies weight per event time instead. two agree limit double-precision arithmetic event times distinct, diverge materially times tied: largest deviation observed (2.75e-04, survival::lung row) roughly two orders magnitude sampling variability global estimate data size – bootstrap standard deviation C_global fit 2.08e-02. affect practical conclusion. documented user cross-checking survival tied data otherwise reasonably suspect bug. Harrell column zero floating-point precision throughout: exactly 0 continuous times survival::lung, single unit rounding error (1.11e-16, .e. one bit) times tied rounded whole days. agreement limit double-precision arithmetic, approximation. Per-pair weighting requirement rather preference: weight attached event time partitioned event-event event-censored pair sets, decomposition package computes defined counting-process formulation. Harrell’s weighting unaffected matches survival::concordance() exactly every tie pattern.
code: tie_agreement <- function(time, status, risk) {   ref_h <- concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ risk, reverse = TRUE)$concordance   ref_u <- concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ risk,     reverse = TRUE,     timewt = "n/G2"   )$concordance   fit_h <- decompose_cindex(time, status, risk, weights = weights_harrell())   fit_u <- decompose_cindex(time, status, risk, weights = weights_uno())   c(harrell = fit_h$C_global - ref_h, uno = fit_u$C_global - ref_u) }  # Day-scale rounding mimics how survival time is actually recorded (whole # days), which is what makes exact ties common rather than exceptional. time_days <- round(time * 30) + 1 lung2 <- lung[complete.cases(lung), ]  tie_raw <- rbind(   `Continuous times`   = tie_agreement(time, status, risk),   `Day-scale, rounded` = tie_agreement(time_days, status, risk),   `survival::lung`     = tie_agreement(lung2$time, lung2$status - 1, lung2$age) )  tie_tab <- data.frame(   Data = rownames(tie_raw),   `Harrell agreement` = formatC(tie_raw[, "harrell"], format = "e", digits = 2),   `Uno agreement` = formatC(tie_raw[, "uno"], format = "e", digits = 2),   check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL ) knitr::kable(tie_tab, align = c("l", "r", "r"))

what: Decompose a concordance index into Event-Event and Event-Censored parts — decompose_cindex
title: Decompose a concordance index into Event-Event and Event-Censored parts — decompose_cindex
text: Splits concordance index two ranking tasks pools: pairs subjects event (C_ee), pairs one event one censored (C_ec). censoring rises event-event pairs vanish C_ec dominates global score, model close chance true events can still report stable global C-index. decomposition applies concordance index form C = sum(w_ij * c_ij) / sum(w_ij). weighting chosen weights_harrell(), weights_uno(), weights_truncated() weights_custom(), identity C = (W_ee * C_ee + W_ec * C_ec) / (W_ee + W_ec) holds .

Event-Event concordance is near chance (0.50). #>   ! Global C-index is below 0.50. If the risk score is oriented #>     so that higher means lower hazard, set higher_is_riskier = FALSE. #>   Pair counts describe composition, not precision. Set n_boot > 0 for intervals. decompose_cindex(time, status, risk, weights = weights_uno()) #> C-Index Decomposition #> Weighting: Uno (IPCW) | n = 200, events = 131 (65.5%), censoring 34.5% #>  #>                     C-index       pairs    share #>   Event-Event        0.4956       8,515    67.3% #>   Event-Censored     0.4520       4,132    32.7% #>   ---------------------------------------------- #>   Global             0.4818      12,647   100.0% #>  #>   Masking gap (C_ec - C_ee): -0.044 #>   ! Event-Event concordance is near chance (0.50). #>   ! Global C-index is below 0.50. If the risk score is oriented #>     so that higher means lower hazard, set higher_is_riskier = FALSE. #>   Pair counts describe composition, not precision. Set n_boot > 0 for intervals.

title: cindexdecomp 0.2.0
text: first argument decompose_cindex() now x rather time, required S3 dispatch. Calls written decompose_cindex(time = t, status = s, risk = r) fail self-explanatory error pointing fix (call positionally, use x =, use formula method) rather bare argument "x" missing dispatch failure. decompose_cindex() returns cindex_decomp object rather plain list. Existing element access ($CI_ee) becomes $C_ee. simulate_censoring() renamed censoring_curve() now returns cindex_curve object, plain data frame. Results $data (via .data.frame()), columns renamed: ci_ee/ci_ec/global_c become C_ee/C_ec/C_global, n_ee/n_ec become N_ee/N_ec, gap low_precision new. plot_simulation() plot_decomposition() replaced autoplot() methods.

title: cindexdecomp 0.2.0
text: Event-censored pairs tied times dropped. size error grows tie density. Survival times normally recorded whole days, ties common: realistic day-scale fixture (300 subjects, ~211 distinct times) bug loses 53 comparable pairs biases estimate +9.0e-05 relative survival::concordance(); earlier, heavily tied fixture (~31 distinct times 300 subjects) loss reached 1,062 pairs bias +0.0007. simulate_censoring() discarded every already-censored subject computing, reported censoring rate among events . cut-whose true cohort censoring 51% reported 20%. Global C-index values 0.50 inverted, reporting 0.42 model 0.58 breaking decomposition identity. Orientation now declared via higher_is_riskier. C_ec values 0.50 silently set NA. Estimates longer discarded magnitude; censoring_curve()’s min_pairs argument flags rows low_precision instead deleting (decompose_cindex() equivalent threshold). Plots longer request “Arial” font family, absent many Linux systems, longer impose fixed axis limits hid worse--chance models. bootstrap_decomp() discarded entire replicate (C_ee, C_ec, C_global gap set NA) whenever either side zero weight, instead NA’ing empty side point estimate already . small samples heavy censoring silently threw away usable single-sided draws shrink effective bootstrap size. dumbbell autoplot() suppressed error bars every model compare_decompositions() plot even one model unstable bootstrap confidence interval. Bars now shown per model. autoplot() cindex_curve draw shaded band inverted threshold masking gap negative. autoplot() single cindex_decomp longer labels row literal placeholder "model". validate_survival_inputs() now rejects non-numeric status (e.g. status = c("0", "1")), previously passed silently. censoring_curve()’s n_thresholds argument now validated; invalid value errors immediately instead surfacing later confusing message internal quantile calculation. n_boot = Inf now gives package’s validation error instead confusing internal one. malformed custom weight function (weights_custom()) returning wrong length now gets error message, distinct “negative non-finite”.
